# Personal Website Instructions

Follow the repository's `AGENTS.md`. This is a static personal website served from `_jonbarron_preview/site/`, with content sources in `_jonbarron_preview/content/`.

Use `migrate.py` for generated pages. Preserve the three standalone project HTML files. Check affected pages, asset links, and mobile layouts. Project captions describe content without image provenance or slide numbers. Do not introduce Jekyll/Docker dependencies or publish without a user request.
